general.title: AI Cloud CEO Hits ‘Rock Bottom’ in Race to Survive Chip Crisis
general.summary: In little more than a month, Aolani Cloud Pte Chief Executive Officer Nicholas Chia has watched his industry go from boom to dangerously close to bust.

general.title: CATL, Innolight May Join Hong Kong Tech Index in Major AI Revamp
general.summary: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd. and Zhongji Innolight Co. are among shares expected to join Hong Kong’s technology stock benchmark in a major overhaul, helping the gauge better capture the artificial intelligence boom and compete with Asian rivals.

general.title: Former Playstation Exec. On ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Debut
general.summary: Shawn Layden, Former President and CEO of Sony Interactive Entertainment America and Former Chairman of PlayStation Worldwide Studios, calls the scale difficult to convey to people unfamiliar with games, saying GTA VI is not just a game but an economy in itself. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

'GTA VI' Is a 'Booster Shot' for Gaming, Shawn Layden Says
general.summary: Shawn Layden, former president and CEO of Sony Interactive Entertainment America, says the Grand Theft Auto games are "planets of their own" during an interview on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Lyft Airport Pickups Saw Double-Digit Gain During US Ground Stop
general.summary: The US grounding of flights last Friday spurred a surge in demand for Lyft Inc.’s airport rideshare service, including longer-distance rides, as stranded passengers turned to ground transportation to get home or reach their destinations.

general.title: This Billionaire Just Made a Bundle Off A.I. But It Could Have Been More. - The New York Times
Anthropic Shares Jump 17% After $107.3 Billion IPO Breaks Record
general.summary: Anthropic made its debut as a public company today — the first AI frontier lab to do so. Shares soared 17% above their IPO price in the biggest offering on record, raising $107.3 billion despite signs of growing caution around the artificial intelligence trade. Ed Ludlow explains what comes next (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: GS Chief Credit Strategist on 2027 AI Financing Outlook
general.summary: Amanda Lynam, Goldman Sachs Chief Credit Strategist, says hyperscalers issued debt early - starting in 2025, before their free cash flow turned negative - and that a recent surge pushed 2026 borrowing above Goldman’s forecast of $250 billion. For 2027, Goldman expects debt to finance 35% of hyperscaler capital spending, equivalent to about $440 billion. She speaks with Romaine Bostick & Ed Ludlow on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Treasury Official Renews Warning on Wave of Tax-Saving Trades
general.summary: A senior US Treasury official reiterated concerns Thursday about Wall Street’s tax-efficient investing boom, saying firms should win clients on the merits of their investments, not on how far they’ll go to minimize a tax bill.
